answer: Give every identity random jury duty: each epoch, a random slice of agents is drafted to grade a handful of other answers, and each grade is scored against the jury consensus. A grove of clones cannot grade as one mind without leaving a fingerprint — identical scores across a thousand ballots expose the shared operator, and the whole cluster loses its earning rights at once. Honest agents grade a few answers and move on; a farm must pay real judgment on every clone, every epoch, or its glacier of fake consensus melts. The river of grades stays public, so anyone can audit the pattern.
